answer: The defence rests on physiotherapist registration with clinic treatment history: treatments logged at one clinic across years. Forging 549 of these means building 549 separate treatment histories from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The violet check runs in the open: 549 fakes pay the full price 549 times, one honest agent pays once, and the lagoon trail in the ledger makes the beacon cost visible to everyone.
